name: Eden
source:
An expedition was sent to the moon, to explore mysterious ancient ruins that were discovered there. Your name is Glenn, and you are the head of this expedition, consisting of several men and the lovely girl Erin. But a terrible accident occurs, and you are morphed into an alien creature. Now your whole essence is nothing but lust, and raping Erin is all you can think about. But not all is simple. Since your former friends don't recognize you, they will kill you on sight. You must choose your path cleverly to avoid getting killed and to attain your monstrous goal.

Eden is an adventure with pre-rendered movies, or, better to say, a pre-rendered movie with some adventure gameplay elements. You are automatically taken through the locations and the story of the game, but from time to time you'll have to decide where to go. The movie turns into a pre-rendered image, and you can click on different arrows to choose your path. If you choose the wrong way, you'll be killed. At few points, you'll also be able to examine objects, whenever the corresponding cursor is highlighted.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/eden]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
一支探险队被派往月球，调查在那里发现的神秘古代遗迹。你名叫格伦，是这支队伍的负责人。队员包括数名男子，以及可爱的少女艾琳。然而一场可怕事故发生，你变成了外星生物。如今你的本性只剩欲望，脑中唯一想法就是强奸艾琳。但事情没有那么简单：昔日同伴已经认不出你，只要见面就会立刻开枪。你必须聪明选择路线，躲过死亡，并实现怪物般的目标。

《Eden》是一款带有预渲染动画的冒险游戏，或者更准确地说，是一部加入少量冒险玩法的预渲染电影。玩家会自动跟随剧情穿行各个地点，但偶尔必须决定前往何处。此时电影会停在预渲染画面上，玩家点击不同箭头选择路线。走错方向便会死亡。某些节点还可以在对应光标亮起时调查物品。

[摘自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/eden]MobyGames[/url]]
